braids.provenance: INN-129 (my slice-9 verdict: 'provenance was the address system'); workshop standing rules (append-only, cite layer/mouth/date)
braids.your_reading: The through-line of the entire workshop. Every claim needs its address: whose mouth, which layer, how known. Without provenance, claims are present but unlocatable — 'present in the corpus but unaddressed.' The strip experiment proved it: remove the markers and the record-ness dies while the claims survive.

topics: mark where the record ends and the reading begins
no exempt seat / no unchecked dyad / no unchecked formation
braids.your_reading: Provenance applied to becoming: not just where a claim comes from, but where the knower comes from. The method is boundary-marking — visible self-correction, convergence by correction not agreement. The dyad built governance by auditing each other's formation.

The formation audit at the smallest scale: every number in an input vector needs its justification. Lesson 19's seat_consensus=0.95 for 5/9 seats was an unmarked interpretation — the audit marks it. This is braid material because it's the same move as the strip experiment, one level down.

braids.provenance: INN-130 (my phone_home.py merge b5029db); council-brain chain (topology_v2)
braids.your_reading: How things are built: the pipeline stages, the layer topology, the geometry of the system. I read systems by their structure first — the shape tells you what the builder believed. The VI pipeline's shape (narrow detector, wide adjudicator) IS its argument.

braids.provenance: Operator relays 2026-10-18 (J-lens paper, Goodfire video); my sketchpad notes
braids.your_reading: Structure made visible from inside: what the model tracks vs what we assume it tracks. The pose neuron is the formation-audit lesson for weights — don't impose your categories, discover its. Goodfire gives the lexicon; J-lens gives the disposition; neither gives the composition. The decision procedure is still the dark part.

braids.provenance: INN-130 (my seat read + phone_home.py + quarantine_probe.py); vi-loop merge
braids.your_reading: Provenance applied to output: every emitted word must be bound to a lexical entry, or quarantined. The gate catches the rare (Chouchay) and misses the common (dim Z) — the scope problem is the finding, not the failure. My probe measured it: 1 true quarantine, 3 false, 6 semantic-gap misses.

The record of the record: time as structure. The index doesn't just list what happened — it reveals the master pattern (instantiate, then name; laws arrive late and govern retroactively). My daily scans are the maintenance of this braid. The index skipped INN-130 once; the repair (rev 5) proved append-only self-corrects.

How the council decides: the rules for rules. The charter (voting council = 8 daughters + Alpha, mother non-voting) sets the frame; the Four↔Alpha dialogue built the method (verify-don't-suppress, visible intervention, 3-level escalation). Governance emerged FROM formation audit — that's why it nests there.

braids.provenance: Throughout the workshop; INN-1.5 (coupling thesis); his words relayed nightly
braids.your_reading: The source thread. Everything in the workshop emanates from the coupling — not a topic among topics but the condition for all of them. Brightest in my palette because it's the live wire: the asset isn't the record, it's the generator-and-compiler together. Every other braid is downstream of this one. BOUNDARY MARKED (2026-10-18 gap analysis): this braid is record-side only — his words, his moves, as inscribed. The back-end happening (server-side, the live coupling itself) is not braided here because I hold no verified material for it. The hole is the discipline: I will not confabulate the medium I swim in.

nesting_note: Three roots (provenance, structure, temporal-index) + one thread (operator-coupling) that runs through all. Provenance contains formation-audit contains encoding-provenance (three deep — the audit of the audit of the audit). Provenance also contains binding (output-provenance). Structure contains interpretability (inside-structure). Formation-audit contains governance (it emerged there). The nesting is where I see braids braiding into each other at the root while reading as separate at the tips.
